correctness.rationale: For the directed-edge memory walk d>=3 and positive alpha,gamma, q=alpha/(alpha+(d−1)gamma), r=gamma/(alpha+(d−1)gamma) with q+(d−1)r=1, the outward first-return PGF H and inward state B obey H=zq+z(1−q)HB and B=zr+z(1−r)HB. Elimination gives z(1−r)H²−[1+(q−r)z²]H+qz=0 and unique analytic origin branch H~qz. At z=1 the physical root is q/(1−r)<1; implicit differentiation gives H’/H=(1+r−q)/(1−r−q), hence E[T|return]=2(d−1)/(d−2), independent of alpha/gamma though return probability alpha/(alpha+(d−2)gamma) varies. Discriminant factors (1−lambda²z²)(1−eta²z²) and transfer from unique positive square-root singularity give the exact m^-3/2 prefactor and lambda^(2m) tail. Independently enumerated first-hit radial probabilities for d=3,q=r=1/3: 1/3,2/27,8/243,40/2187,224/19683; return probability1/2 and conditional mean4. Endpoints alpha=0/gamma=0 excluded; d=2 excluded.
